(Currently Amended) 1. A method comprising: receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the received requests specifically relate to particular bankruptcy filings; automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the batch filing includes validating the bankruptcy documents before submission.

(Currently Amended) 6. A method comprising: receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a corresponding data record for generating a proof of claim; automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the batch filing includes validating the proofs of claims before submission.
